**Nationality:** Honduran · **Address:** Tegucigalpa, Honduras\
**Email:** lalgonzales@gmail.com · **LinkedIn:** linkedin.com/in/lalgonzales · **GitHub:** github.com/lalgonzales · **Website:** lalgonzales.github.io

## About me

Forest engineer with more than ten years of work in forest monitoring, geospatial analysis and remote sensing for the conservation of forests and natural resources in Honduras. I build reproducible workflows in Python, PostGIS, QGIS and Google Earth Engine for land-cover change, deforestation alerts and cadastre, and I teach QGIS and Python to public-sector teams. I have worked for the national forest institute (ICF), international cooperation (FAO, IDB-funded projects) and community forestry federations.
